laws.rule: Braulio Carrillo (Quebrada González and Volcán Barva sectors): daily 8 am to 3:30 pm. Non-resident adults US$13.56 (about A$19.26 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children 2 to 12 US$5.65 (about A$8.03 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). No entry drunk or on drugs, no pets, no smoking (Law 9028), no loud sound equipment, no political or religious activities.
